segments.he:
א.

אִשָּׁה כְּשֵׁרָה מְטַהֶרֶת הַבַּיִת מִצָּרָעַת.
segments.en: (having to move constantly from place to another)
Through wandering, one merits a good name.
For the most part, the G-d fearing – their livelihood comes through having to go from place to place.
Sometimes the  T zaddik  comes to wander, so that when he comes to the World to Come, he will remember all the places he had been, and through this, good will come to those places.

Not in every place does a person merit to have fortunate attainment of Torah and good deeds. For this reason, the Holy One Blessed He brings about circumstances causing the person to leave one place and go to another.
Sometimes a person is obliged to suffer exile, and it is switched for him to some sickness.
An upright woman purifies the house from leprosy (t.n.  in Likutay Moharan 21 Rabbi Nachman reveals that leprosy can refer to the shutout of supernal light) .
